The role ensures technical correctness reliability and maintainability while delivering medium to high complexity features and integrations on schedule.

The role is focused on developing software solutions, complex scripts, custom modules (custom DLLs), components and integration solutions. You will participate in the technical design of solutions, integrations with other information systems, performance optimization, testing and the technical implementation of complete project components. We are looking for a developer who can independently take ownership of assigned development tasks, solve technical challenges and deliver reliable and maintainable solutions, while working closely with senior developers and other members of the project team. Key Responsibilities: · Independently develop software solutions and integrations of medium to high complexity. · Develop and implement complex scripts, custom modules, custom DLLs and software components. · Participate in the technical design and implementation of software solutions. · Develop integrations between BPM/DMS systems and other information systems. · Work with APIs and different data exchange mechanisms. · Test implemented solutions and troubleshoot technical issues. · Optimize the performance, stability and reliability of software solutions. · Analyze technical requirements and contribute to selecting appropriate implementation approaches. · Participate in the technical implementation of complete project components. · Collaborate with senior developers, technical leads, consultants and other project team members. · Follow development, security, quality and maintainability standards. Responsibilities & Ownership The Medior Software Engineer is responsible for the technical correctness, reliability, security and maintainability of the software and integration solutions they develop and implement, as well as for the quality and timely delivery of assigned development tasks. Requirements: · 2–3+ years of professional software development experience. · Knowledge of .NET / C# technologies. · Good understanding of object-oriented programming principles. · Experience developing business applications and software components. · Good knowledge of relational databases and SQL. · Understanding of system integration concepts and practices. · Experience working with REST/SOAP services and data formats such as JSON and XML. · Ability to independently analyze problems and identify appropriate technical solutions. · Understanding of software testing, debugging and performance optimization. · Ability to work on complex business applications and integration projects. · Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. · Responsible, systematic and team-oriented approach to work. Nice to Have: · Experience working with BPM and/or DMS systems. · Experience developing custom DLLs and other custom software components. · Experience with relational databases such as MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL or Oracle. · Knowledge of integration patterns and middleware technologies. · Experience working on enterprise software solutions. What We Offer: · The opportunity to work on complex BPM, DMS and enterprise integration projects. · Involvement in the complete technical lifecycle of software solutions – from design and development to testing, optimization and implementation. · A high level of autonomy in the execution of development tasks.

As our platform grows in transactional volume, regulatory demands, and third-party integrations, we need engineers who can turn these challenges into working, reliable solutions. Real Azure experience : App Services, Azure SQL, Key Vault, Application Gateway/WAF, Log Analytics/Application Insights; CI/CD with GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps. jobs.details: Software Eng (Dev) III Software Eng (Dev) III IGT D&B d.o.o. 3.7 Beograd | Hibrid 22.10.2026. C# OOP Unity Agile intermediate Your growth matters. At IGT, we're building a culture where people Innovate with Purpose, Compete Intensely & Win, Lead with Heart, Make It Matter, and Create Value. Grow your career while helping shape what's next. Build what's next at IGT. C# Game Developer – IGT Blue Goat Studio Join IGT's Blue Goat Studio in Belgrade and help create world-class casino games enjoyed by millions of players around the globe. We are looking for a talented and passionate C# Game Developer who thrives on building high-quality, high-performance games and transforming creative concepts into robust, production-ready solutions. In this role, you will work closely with game designers, artists, mathematicians, and QA engineers to bring engaging game experiences to life. Your contributions will play a key role in ensuring our games are visually compelling, technically excellent, and optimized for performance. What You Will Do As a C# Game Developer, you will help transform creative ideas, mathematical models, and artistic vision into engaging gaming experiences. You will work in a highly collaborative environment, partnering with teams in Belgrade and across our global organization. Your responsibilities will include: Develop casino games and game features using C# and Unity for deployment on gaming machines in casinos worldwide. Implement new functionality using our established game framework with a strong focus on visual quality and player experience. Collaborate closely with technical artists and designers to deliver engaging and polished game features. Implement game logic and mathematical models that drive gameplay. Optimize game performance, memory usage, and loading times to meet platform requirements. Estimate development effort and actively participate in sprint planning, Agile ceremonies, and technical discussions. Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve issues throughout the development lifecycle. Work closely with game designers, mathematicians, artists, and QA engineers to develop effective solutions and continuously improve game quality. Contribute to maintaining high coding standards, code quality, and application stability. What We're Looking For Minimum of 3 years of relevant software development experience. Exceptional candidates with less experience and a strong aptitude for learning are also encouraged to apply. Professional experience developing applications using C#. Strong understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP) principles and software design practices. Experience with Unity or a similar game/application development framework is highly desirable but not required. Experience developing event-driven applications. Understanding of application performance optimization, memory management, and efficient code practices. Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, Agile development environment. Good written and spoken English communication skills, as you will collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders across multiple international locations. Benefits and culture Permanent employment contract and a competitive salary. Private health insurance for you and your family. Flexible working hours, including a hybrid work model, along with various initiatives that support wellbeing and work-life balance. Opportunity to learn and continuously improve your skills
